
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yupi/p/19340340" title="发布于 2025-12-12 11:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">干掉 Draw.io，这个程序员画图神器杀疯了！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2225420/202512/2225420-20251212104127952-539835905.png" alt="干掉 Draw.io，这个程序员画图神器杀疯了！" class="desc_img">
        我在 编程导航 上看到了这个最近大火的 AI 画图神器，完全免费开源，短短几天就涨了 6k star，值得收藏！
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">这年头谁还人工画图啊？我用 AI 几十秒就搞定了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425512752-36836e48-71ce-46c2-84ae-8c9b28ad7a1b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425512752-36836e48-71ce-46c2-84ae-8c9b28ad7a1b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">我在 <span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://codefather.cn/" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">编程导航</span></a><span class="md-plain"> 上看到了这个最近大火的 AI 画图神器，完全免费开源，短短几天就涨了 6k star，值得收藏！</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">开源指路：<span class="md-link md-pair-s"><a href="https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io</a></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425690148-db18c63c-6666-4a0b-a681-0ad4a5c061c3.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425690148-db18c63c-6666-4a0b-a681-0ad4a5c061c3.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这个项目支持在线体验，你可以完全从 0 开始画图，比如画一个流程图，演示 RAG 的工作原理。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">⭐️ 建议观看视频演示：<span class="md-link md-pair-s"><a href="https://bilibili.com/video/BV18NmnB4EeM" rel="noopener nofollow">https://bilibili.com/video/BV18NmnB4EeM</a></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">AI 会自动生成 Draw.io 绘图代码，很快精美的流程图就搞定了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425750546-988f6dd9-552b-403f-a1ea-f8866c309663.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425750546-988f6dd9-552b-403f-a1ea-f8866c309663.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">然后你可以利用 Draw.io 自身强大的绘图能力手动修改任意元素、或者是改变风格样式。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425788858-d420461d-aaee-4977-b64d-ebac25a0d340.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425788858-d420461d-aaee-4977-b64d-ebac25a0d340.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">也可以通过 AI 对话让它帮你修改，比如改成动画连接线，逼格一下子就上来了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425815484-e879ea8a-d40a-4857-baab-4124c3eedcee.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425815484-e879ea8a-d40a-4857-baab-4124c3eedcee.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">还有程序员工作涉及的架构图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：绘制电商平台的微服务架构图</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425829760-5337eb51-a51a-4327-a1e0-66b6f4ce2176.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425829760-5337eb51-a51a-4327-a1e0-66b6f4ce2176.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">UML 类图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：用 UML 类图展示用户管理模块的设计</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425843465-53ebe0d1-0df4-46b1-8b27-1bdd98333f5d.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425843465-53ebe0d1-0df4-46b1-8b27-1bdd98333f5d.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">ER 图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：绘制在线教育平台的数据库 ER 图</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425852509-4685b9ff-9c86-430c-9e7e-fd1f75877c51.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425852509-4685b9ff-9c86-430c-9e7e-fd1f75877c51.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">时序图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：用时序图展示用户登录的交互过程</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425862905-cab2301b-77c2-47e4-adc1-6d7c617cd33b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425862905-cab2301b-77c2-47e4-adc1-6d7c617cd33b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">知识讲解图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：用动画演示冒泡排序的执行过程</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425875775-b53a9621-acbf-4236-9e50-c080b12790e0.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425875775-b53a9621-acbf-4236-9e50-c080b12790e0.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">甚至是沙雕图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：让程序员鱼皮卑微地求用户点赞</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425887493-d10d0c4d-09b4-49be-a52f-aecc6ce5ebf5.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425887493-d10d0c4d-09b4-49be-a52f-aecc6ce5ebf5.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这些通通不在话下，帮你节省大把的时间和毛发~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425946391-0aa1e72d-1f53-478c-8d6c-1d6524556985.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425946391-0aa1e72d-1f53-478c-8d6c-1d6524556985.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">还有一些使用小技巧，比如配合免费的图标库，让整个绘图元素更丰富。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：使用 AWS 图标生成 CDN 架构图</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426030861-27a70a15-559b-4540-9177-5e5f66d120b0.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426030861-27a70a15-559b-4540-9177-5e5f66d120b0.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">可以使用原生 SVG 动画标签，给整个绘图增加缩放和路径动画（不过支持的动画很有限）。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：演示 DDOS 攻击，使用 SVG 的 <span class="md-tag md-raw-inline">&lt;animateMotion&gt;<span class="md-plain"> 和 <span class="md-tag md-raw-inline">&lt;animateTransform type="scale"&gt;<span class="md-plain"> 增加缩放和路径动画</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425981962-4a730008-8a64-4805-adfc-a63a983e4fde.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765425981962-4a730008-8a64-4805-adfc-a63a983e4fde.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">还可以自己上传一个草图，比如我用文本模型生成的 Mermaid 流程图，让 AI 帮我替换为更美观的样式风格。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">提示词：改为彩虹主题的配色、放大字体、使用加粗动画连接线</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">效果还不错吧！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426075534-26f6f2a7-8ee9-421f-ad10-4910b2b7df34.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426075534-26f6f2a7-8ee9-421f-ad10-4910b2b7df34.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">最后导出为各种图片或文档格式，美滋滋~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765268527840-a3717305-7bba-4533-8595-c92c21bcd021.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765268527840-a3717305-7bba-4533-8595-c92c21bcd021.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">注意，官方提供的演示网站可能限量和不稳定，像我连续用了几次就被拒绝了：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426131345-5dcc9b6c-e601-4516-9d55-bef56bec734f.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426131345-5dcc9b6c-e601-4516-9d55-bef56bec734f.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">所以我建议下载开源代码到本地，按照官方文档的说法 <span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://github.com/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io/blob/main/docs/ai-providers.md" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">配置自己的大模型</span></a><span class="md-plain"> 来运行；或者用 Docker 一键启动，想怎么用就怎么用。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426188076-914514ec-c5cd-4ac5-8ca7-e09f0808801e.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426188076-914514ec-c5cd-4ac5-8ca7-e09f0808801e.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">最后多说两句，这个项目的实现其实并不复杂。作者通过集成 Vercel AI SDK 轻松对接各种大模型，让 AI 生成 draw.io 能理解的 XML 代码，然后直接使用开源的 draw.io 代码实现了核心的绘图展示和编辑能力，整个过程和 AI 生成网站是类似的。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426020824-c5fe5eef-6a62-4810-951a-8aabe6c26c5b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765426020824-c5fe5eef-6a62-4810-951a-8aabe6c26c5b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你学会了吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
